name: DISABLE_MALI_COMPAT
description: Loader switch that forces the compat layer off even when ENABLE_MALI_COMPAT is set.

name: DISABLE_MALI_WSI
description: Loader switch that forces the WSI layer off.

name: ENABLE_MALI_COMPAT
description: Loads the compat layer (implicit Vulkan layer); DroidDeck sets it for bridge games. Nothing below has an effect without it.

name: ENABLE_MALI_WSI
description: Loads the Arm window-system-integration layer (Wayland/X11 swapchains on the vendor driver). Nothing MALI_WSI_* has an effect without it.

name: MALI_BRIDGE_DEBUG
description: ICD shim logs to stderr.

name: MALI_BRIDGE_HAL
description: Load another HAL instead of the phone vendor Vulkan driver.

name: MALI_COMPAT_ADDRMAP
description: GPU address map for a vendor GPU MMU fault: which Vulkan object lay at the faulting GPU VA. Turns the memlog on (/root/mali-memlog-<comm>.tsv, size cap 256 MiB unless MEMLOG_MB is set) and adds bind, destroy, layer-allocation, marker, submit and clock events. Reports only; nothing the driver gets changes.

name: MALI_COMPAT_AS_FIX
description: The acceleration-structure part of the RT emulation (AS tracking, layer-side CLONE copy against the vendor driver's CLONE overrun, build planning with layer scratch, AS address checks) for a ray-query game without MALI_COMPAT_RT_PIPELINE; RT_PIPELINE=1 implies it. Off: every AS call reaches the driver untouched.

name: MALI_COMPAT_ASYNC_PSO
description: Compile graphics pipelines on worker threads and wait at most this many ms; a slower one returns a stand-in whose draws are dropped until ready (pop-in instead of a stall). 0 = off.

name: MALI_COMPAT_ASYNC_THREADS
description: Worker threads for ASYNC_PSO.

name: MALI_COMPAT_BC_AFRC
description: BC textures keep fixed-rate (AFRC) compressed shadow images; 0 = uncompressed shadows (needs much more GPU memory).

name: MALI_COMPAT_BDA_EXT
description: vkCreateDevice also enables VK_KHR_buffer_device_address when the app did not and the driver has it. The BC decode needs vkGetBufferDeviceAddress; an app on Vulkan 1.0/1.1 without the extension would otherwise skip every BC texture upload (counted as bc-dec nobda). Also switches on the bc-dec counts log line.

name: MALI_COMPAT_BUDGET_LOG_S
description: Interval of the budget log line (printed only with GPU_TIME or DEBUG).

name: MALI_COMPAT_BUDGET_MB
description: VK_EXT_memory_budget with live accounting, heapBudget capped at this size in MiB (0 = default report: min(heap, 6 GiB)).

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM
description: Cover-trim: limits the listed screen-space AO compute dispatches and the composite draw to the screen cells near the weapon camera geometry (The Long Dark). Needs the hash lists below.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_ARM
description: <mrt>:<maxdraws>: arm after a pass with at least that many colour targets and at most that many draws.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_CS
description: Compute shader hashes to trim, optional extra dilation in px.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_FS
description: Composite fragment shader hashes to trim.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_GRID
description: <nx>x<ny> cell grid (nx*ny <= 64).

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_K
description: Extra dilation in dispatch groups.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_MARGIN
description: Margin in px around the covered tiles.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_MAXOPS
description: Trimmed operations per arming.

name: MALI_COMPAT_COVER_TRIM_TOGGLE
description: Trim only while this file exists (A/B inside one launch).

name: MALI_COMPAT_DEBUG
description: Compat layer logging.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DEPTH_EQUAL
description: Replaces the EQUAL depth compare op of no-write graphics pipelines (HZD G-buffer test).

name: MALI_COMPAT_DEPTH_NOCOMP
description: Create sampled depth/stencil images uncompressed.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE
description: Captures resolved descriptor bindings of these compute shaders to a TSV (costs time and disk).

name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE_FILE
description: Output of DESC_CAPTURE.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_CAPTURE_MB
description: Size cap in MiB of DESC_CAPTURE.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_POOL_PAD
description: Adds every core descriptor type a pool does not list, n x maxSets.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_POOL_SCALE
description: Multiplies maxSets and every descriptor count of each descriptor pool (the vendor driver enforces pool counts); falls back to the app's sizes if the scaled pool fails.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DPOOL_DIAG
description: Descriptor-pool lifetime diagnostic: counts vkResetDescriptorPool / vkFreeDescriptorSets / vkDestroyDescriptorPool per pool and second, and logs each one that releases sets a submitted, not yet finished command buffer bound (reset-while-pending), plus binds/submits of sets whose pool was already reset. Nothing the driver gets changes. Unset = follows MALI_COMPAT_ADDRMAP (on with it, into its memlog TSV, replacing the per-call dpool-reset lines); 1 = on without ADDRMAP (own file, MALI_COMPAT_DPOOL_LOG); 0 = off.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DPOOL_LOG
description: Output file of DPOOL_DIAG when ADDRMAP is off.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DEVICE_ID
description: PCI device ID reported together with VENDOR_ID.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DEVICE_NAME
description: Device name reported together with VENDOR_ID.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_EXPORT
description: Emulates dma-buf export: exportable linear images get dma-heap memory imported into the driver (gamescope nested backend).

name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_HEAP
description: The dma-heap used by DMABUF_EXPORT.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DMABUF_PEEK
description: Every 5 s how much of each exported buffer is non-zero.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DRM_NODE
description: Reports VK_EXT_physical_device_drm with this character device (e.g. /dev/mali0) as primary and render node (gamescope).

name: MALI_COMPAT_DSL_STAGE_RETRY
description: Retries a failed descriptor set layout with stageFlags & 0x3f3f.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DUMP_HASH
description: Writes shaders with these hashes to /root/mali-spv-<hash>.spv.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DUMP_RT_SPV
description: Directory for the RT megakernel .spv dumps (rt_mega_p<i>_<hash>.spv, also the split select kernel); 0 or off = no dump files.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FAIL_LOG
description: Logs failing shader modules, pipelines, descriptor layouts/pools/sets to stderr (2 = also the first successful calls).

name: MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_OCCLUSION
description: Every occlusion query reads as visible.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_ALIGN
description: Clamp minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment to 16 (752c09f's DOOM Eternal override, default since 11-07 the driver's real value). RE Village needs it to load.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_LIMITS
description: FAKE_ALIGN and FAKE_SUBGROUP together (752c09f's overrides, on for every game up to v0.2.0; they break Watch Dogs 2). DOOM Eternal needs them to start.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SG_LOG
description: 1: scans every shader module for subgroup instructions (read only) and logs which stages use them; the first modules with any are dumped to /root/mali-sg-<hash>.spv. 2: every such module is dumped (up to 128 files). For DOOM Eternal's faked vertex-stage subgroup support.

name: MALI_COMPAT_BCD_RING
description: Keeps the last 4096 BC decode regions (source read / staging write GPU address ranges) and 512 staging frees; dumped to stderr when pushes and decodes stall for 20 s, for a GPU page fault. Also logs bcd-mix counters: BC decodes recorded into command buffers holding app push constants / app pipeline binds, push records dropped or not recorded (the restore after a decode).

name: MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_SUBGROUP
description: Widen the reported subgroup supportedStages to VERTEX/TESS/GEOMETRY (and supportedOperations to BASIC..QUAD), 752c09f's DOOM Eternal override; default since 11-07 the driver's real masks.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FB_MASK
description: Which classes of full barriers the layer adds (0x0d6 = ALL_COMMANDS src/dst stages and memory access masks on the app barriers, plus full barriers before passes, after dispatches and after copies; 0 = off). Cures the Witcher 3 terrain flashes and the Control shadow flicker.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FORCE_COHERENT
description: Allocations from the non-coherent cached host memory type go to the coherent one of the same heap.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FORCE_COMP
description: Give attachments without STORAGE their compression back when vkd3d-proton asks for none.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FP16_HIDE_PROCS
description: Hides shaderFloat16/shaderInt16 from these processes.

name: MALI_COMPAT_FRAGDEPTH_FIX
description: Removes gl_FragDepth writes in pipelines without a depth/stencil attachment (on by default; 0 = off).

name: MALI_COMPAT_FULL_BARRIERS
description: Diagnosis: ALL_COMMANDS barriers on every app barrier (1) or around every pass/copy/dispatch (2).

name: MALI_COMPAT_GPU_TIME
description: GPU profiler: top passes/dispatches every 5 s, compile times, STUCK lines.

name: MALI_COMPAT_GS_HIDE_PROCS
description: Hides geometryShader from these processes (Xwayland under gamescope).

name: MALI_COMPAT_GT_SPLIT_SKIP
description: With GPU_TIME: no timestamps around suspending/resuming parts (they are invalid there).

name: MALI_COMPAT_GT_TRACE
description: With GPU_TIME: log every pass that uses this shader hash (all = every pass).

name: MALI_COMPAT_MEMLOG
description: Memory event log /root/mali-memlog-<comm>.tsv (2 = without the opaque-address query).

name: MALI_COMPAT_MEMLOG_MB
description: Size cap in MiB of the memory log per process.

name: MALI_COMPAT_NOATT_AREA
description: Clamps DXVK's attachment-less passes (16384x16384, 256 layers) to this area and one layer; they hung the GPU.

name: MALI_COMPAT_NO_SUSPEND_RESUME
description: Turns vkd3d-proton's suspended/resumed render passes into plain passes (fixes blocky sky, needed by Control).

name: MALI_COMPAT_PASSTHRU
description: A/B switch: every call except create/destroy goes straight to the driver (only CreateDevice feature masking stays).

name: MALI_COMPAT_PIPELINE_CACHE
description: Persistent pipeline cache per process (1: /root/.cache/mali-compat/<process>.pcache, fine with DXVK, wrong pipelines with vkd3d-proton) or 2: in memory only, one cache per compile thread.

name: MALI_COMPAT_PIPELINE_CACHE_THREADS
description: Threads that use the pipeline cache; dxvk-cs for DXVK games.

name: MALI_COMPAT_REAL_ALIGN
description: Old key: forces the driver's real minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment (the default since 11-07); wins over FAKE_ALIGN.

name: MALI_COMPAT_REAL_LIMITS
description: Old key: REAL_ALIGN and REAL_SUBGROUP together (the default since 11-07); wins over FAKE_*.

name: MALI_COMPAT_REAL_SUBGROUP
description: Old key: forces the driver's real subgroup masks (the default since 11-07); wins over FAKE_SUBGROUP.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_AS_TRUST
description: RT emulation: no acceleration-structure handle recreation on a type change, and no UPDATE to BUILD for unbuilt or mutated ASes (an UPDATE with a null source still becomes a BUILD). Needs RT_PIPELINE or AS_FIX.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_BUILD_LOG
description: RT emulation: per-build log lines for the first N acceleration-structure build calls, and N more after the first TraceRays. 0 = off.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_CLONE
description: RT emulation: the layer copies the source AS's real bytes for a CLONE copy (the vendor driver copies the source's whole created size and overruns); 0 = CLONE goes to the driver.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_CLONE_REFIT
description: RT emulation: the first in-place UPDATE of an AS that was copied into becomes a BUILD; 0 = passed through.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_COMPRESS
description: Render-target compression; learned UAV targets are kept in /root/mali-rt-keep-<process>.txt.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_FORCE_BUILD
description: RT emulation: every UPDATE build becomes a full BUILD (source cleared).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_FREE_STAGES
description: RT emulation: a non-library RT pipeline frees its stage SPIR-V copies once its megakernel SPIR-V is built, and the megakernel shader module once its compute pipeline exists (default: both kept until vkDestroyPipeline). Saves memory.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_GUARD_ITERS
description: RT emulation traversal safety bound: a ray whose ray-query loop runs more than N OpRayQueryProceedKHR iterations is terminated and counted as a miss, so a bad SBT, TLAS or parameter value cannot keep a GPU job alive until the watchdog.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_LOCAL1D
description: RT emulation: a direct trace with height < 4 runs 32 consecutive x per workgroup instead of 8x4 tiles (3 of 4 rows of a height-1 launch are out of bounds).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_MAX_STAGES
description: A/B lever: no megakernel for an RT pipeline with more than N stages; its trace dispatches are skipped and counted. 0 = off.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_MEM_LOG_S
description: Interval in seconds of the rt_mem / vk_mem / rt_rays memory lines (0 = only the final lines at vkDestroyDevice).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_OWN_SCRATCH
description: RT emulation: acceleration-structure builds use the layer's own scratch pool; 0 = keep the app's scratch.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_PARAM_HOSTWRITE
description: A/B lever: per-dispatch RT parameters are written by the host at record time (old behaviour) instead of by the GPU in command-stream order before the dispatch. Set to any value (also 0) = on.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_PIPELINE
description: The app's "Ray tracing: DX12 games (DXR)" switch. Opt-in, off by default. Emulates VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline (and the pipeline-library / deferred-host-operations extensions) over the driver's ray queries: each RT pipeline is compiled into one ray-query compute megakernel, and the acceleration-structure calls are emulated (RT_PIPELINE implies AS_FIX). Needs a lot of GPU memory (layer AS storage and scratch).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SCRATCH_HEAD
description: RT emulation: each AS scratch pool slice gets +max(need, 1 MB) headroom; 0 = exactly the driver's scratch need (64 KB aligned).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SCRATCH_POOL_MB
description: Size in MiB of the layer's acceleration-structure scratch pool (values outside 8..1024 fall back to 128).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SIZE_PAD
description: RT emulation: vkGetAccelerationStructureBuildSizesKHR inflates the driver's sizes (1.5x + 2 MiB AS, 2x + 4 MiB scratch, 64 KB padding). Default 0 = the driver's own sizes (the measured configuration).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SKIP_TRACES
description: Diagnosis: every TraceRays / TraceRaysIndirect is skipped (AS builds kept).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SPLIT
description: RT emulation: a pipeline with 2..8 distinct raygen stages and at least RT_SPLIT_MIN stages gets one megakernel per raygen (GPU-side select plus indirect dispatch per trace) instead of one for the whole pipeline.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SPLIT_JOBS
description: Split-child megakernels compiled at the same time (with RT_SPLIT).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SPLIT_MIN
description: Smallest RT pipeline (stage count) that RT_SPLIT splits.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_STATS
description: Megakernels are created with CAPTURE_STATISTICS: one rt_stats line per executable (needs VK_KHR_pipeline_executable_properties and its feature in the driver).

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_SYNC_COMPILE
description: The megakernel is compiled inside vkCreateRayTracingPipelinesKHR instead of asynchronously.

name: MALI_COMPAT_RT_UPD_SRC
description: RT emulation: an UPDATE whose source AS differs from the destination becomes a BUILD (1, default: the vendor blob breaks on such refits); 2 = only when the source storage is larger than the destination's; 0 = passed through.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SKIP_HASH
description: With GPU_TIME: drop the draws of pipelines with this shader.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SPV_DONTUNROLL
description: Marks every shader loop DontUnroll (against slow compiles).

name: MALI_COMPAT_SPV_FIX
description: Two SPIR-V rewrites against vendor-compiler aborts (u32->u64->float conversions, uniform BroadcastFirst).

name: MALI_COMPAT_SSBO_ALIGN_LOG
description: Counts STORAGE_BUFFER(_DYNAMIC) descriptors written with offset % 64 != 0 (sets, templates, push descriptors, vkGetDescriptorEXT), histogram by remainder 16/32/48/other plus all written; one "mali-compat: ssbo-align:" stderr line per 10 s. Changes nothing (RE Village alignment probe).

name: MALI_COMPAT_STATS
description: Counters every 5 s (every = on every BC upload).

name: MALI_COMPAT_SUBMIT_IDLE
description: Diagnosis: after every queue submit wait for the GPU to go idle (1 = cap 250 ms, else the cap in ms).

name: MALI_COMPAT_SUSRES_BARRIER
description: With NO_SUSPEND_RESUME: one memory barrier before each converted resuming part. Did not fix the Control flicker.

name: MALI_COMPAT_DISP_BARRIER

values.item: 8-hex-digit compute shader hash (GPU_TIME cs:), optional :a / :b / :ab; at most 16; 0 = none

description: Per-shader dispatch barrier: a dispatch (outside a render pass) whose bound compute pipeline has a listed hash gets one global memory barrier (as MALI_COMPAT_FB_MASK 0x040 adds after every dispatch) after it (:a, default), before it (:b) or both (:ab). The sync-diag ctl token db=<list> replaces the list at run time (db=0 clears). A malformed list is refused as a whole (logged). Counted per hash in the sync-diag 10-s line.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_CTL
description: Path of a control file ("fb=2 si=1 k4=0", "fbm=0x0d6", "off db=f1dca4ed:b") read every 250 ms to change the sync-diagnosis mode within one launch.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_LOG
description: Log file of the sync diagnosis.

name: MALI_COMPAT_SYNC_REPORT_S
description: Interval in seconds of the sync-diagnosis counter line.

name: MALI_COMPAT_TRACE
description: With RT_PIPELINE: logs the per-call COMPAT_TRACE lines of the RT emulation (otherwise off; they were logged on every TraceRays call).

name: MALI_COMPAT_VENDOR_ID
description: Reports another PCI vendor ID (driverID stays Arm); 10de also gives the device name "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080" unless DEVICE_ID/NAME are set. 5143 makes vkd3d-proton use push descriptors for root CBVs.

name: MALI_COMPAT_VS_STORES
description: Log-only vertex-stage store scan (on anyway with GPU_TIME).

name: MALI_COMPAT_WAIT_CALLERS
description: With GPU_TIME: per-caller fence-wait statistics in each report.

name: MALI_COMPAT_WLS_CLAMP
description: Clamps every dynamic index into a workgroup-storage array so out-of-range indices stay inside it (stops GPU MMU faults of DXVK TGSM shaders).

name: MALI_COMPAT_WLS_FIX
description: Rewrites the listed compute shaders to a virtual 1-lane subgroup with one workgroup-array slot per invocation (SubgroupSize loads -> 1, ShuffleXor / Broadcast -> identity, short workgroup arrays grown to the invocation count, dynamic indices clamped, loop unroll hints off), so a subgroup-size-indexed shared array written for 32/64 lanes neither overruns on Mali's 16 lanes nor reads out-of-range shuffles. Modules it cannot prove safe are left as they are (logged).

name: MALI_COMPAT_WLS_FIX_MODE
description: Rewrite used by MALI_COMPAT_WLS_FIX (does nothing without it). 1 / lane1: virtual 1-lane subgroup (exact, but invocation 0 reduces every slot serially: DOOM 2.2 ms/frame). 2 / sgid: keeps the real subgroup reduce: each ShuffleXor guarded by SubgroupSize > mask, slot = SubgroupId, slot count = NumSubgroups, reduce loop from 0, short workgroup arrays grown to invocations / 4 and clamped. sgid refuses (module left as it is, logged) unless the module has exactly that slot / count / reduce-loop pattern. Other values: ignored, lane1.

name: MALI_COMPAT_XFB_VS
description: D3D11 stream output: a passthrough capture geometry shader is dropped and the vertex shader captures (Unity GPU skinning: Yooka-Laylee 80-90 FPS against 19-20).

name: MALI_WSI_ASYNC_PRESENT
description: WSI layer: presentation thread also for swapchains without explicit sync; vkQueuePresentKHR returns after the fence submit (Control +8 % FPS). Set to 0 or 1 it logs one line per swapchain.

name: MALI_WSI_FPS
description: WSI layer counts presents and appends "HH:MM:SS fps N.N" every 5 s to /root/mali-wsi-fps.txt (frame rate for games without a HUD).

name: MALI_WSI_NO_10BIT
description: Hides the 10-bit surface formats (test switch).

name: MALI_WSI_PACE
description: Times acquire/flip, writes the pace file.

name: MALI_WSI_PACE_FILE
description: Output file of MALI_WSI_PACE.

name: MALI_WSI_PACE_HZ
description: Pace rate in Hz for MALI_WSI_PACE (period = 1000/Hz ms).

name: MALI_WSI_PROBE_PIXELS
description: Probes the presented pixels (diagnosis).
